title: Lima Marks BTS's First Peru Visit with 'BTS Avenue' Ahead of Three San Marcos Shows
detail: October 7, 2026 — BTS arrived in Lima for their first-ever Peru visit, with three ARIRANG World Tour shows listed at Estadio San Marcos on Oct 7, 9 and 10. The Santiago de Surco district renamed Calle Sacramento 'BTS Avenue' for Oct 5-11, the Arco Morisco at Parque de la Amistad was lit purple with a daily light show, and the Circuito Mágico del Agua hosts a BTS-themed water show. Fans gathered outside the group's Miraflores hotel. Reports of the Oct 7 show itself were not yet available at the time of this update.

media.caption: Lima gets 'BTS Avenue' ahead of the ARIRANG World Tour shows.
